Mira Early Game Guide

Game: Xenoblade Chronicles X.

Mira is a location in Xenoblade Chronicles X. In Xenoblade Chronicles X, early exploration benefits from short planned routes.

Check your equipment and identify a safe return route before exploring Mira. Practice with available attacks near the starting area and avoid enemies beyond your current level. Save frequently so a failed exploration attempt does not lose too much progress.
